# Alastair Banwell

> Independent web designer and developer. I build websites for small, owner-run
> businesses, mostly sports coaches, trades and local services. One person, not an
> agency: the person you speak to is the person who builds the site.

Based in the Western Cape, South Africa, working remotely with clients worldwide,
currently in the United Kingdom, the United States and South Africa.

A full build is a one-off fee, not a subscription. The client owns the site and the
domain. Details on the Pricing page.

## What I do

- Websites for small businesses, built by hand rather than assembled from a template
- Sports coaches and clubs, home services and trades, local retail
- Honest copy and real photography. No invented testimonials, review counts or
  statistics, which is a fixed rule rather than a preference

## Writing

Each post answers one specific question, in plain language, from real client work.

- [Six Small Things That Quietly Cost You Enquiries](https://www.alastairbanwell.com/blog/small-things-that-cost-you-enquiries/): six mechanical faults found on real small business sites, including duplicate email addresses, broken mailto links and template demo content left live. Each with how to check it yourself.
- [Why I Won't Put Fake Numbers On Your Website](https://www.alastairbanwell.com/blog/fake-numbers-on-your-website/): why padded follower counts, invented testimonials and made-up statistics cost more than they gain, and what to do when you genuinely have very little to show.
- [Why People Book A Call And Then Don't Turn Up](https://www.alastairbanwell.com/blog/why-people-miss-booked-calls/): the mechanical reasons booked calls get missed, and the five minute fix.
- [Your Own Website Vs Being Listed On Someone Else's](https://www.alastairbanwell.com/blog/your-own-website-vs-being-listed/): when a directory, marketplace or club listing is enough, and when you need your own site.
- [How Much Should A Small Business Website Actually Cost](https://www.alastairbanwell.com/blog/how-much-a-website-should-cost/): what drives the price of a small business website, and what you are paying for at each level.
- [How A Brand New Website Actually Gets Found By Google](https://www.alastairbanwell.com/blog/how-a-new-site-gets-found/): indexing, sitemaps, structured data and realistic timescales for a site with no history.
- [What Actually Makes A Small Business Website Convert](https://www.alastairbanwell.com/blog/what-actually-converts/): what turns a visitor into an enquiry, drawn from real builds.
